data.description:
SPT 4.1.3 port. All credit to the original author, TadMaj.

Features

  • Right-click any stash item for QuickSell (Flea) and QuickSell (Trader)
  • Keybinds: N flea, M traders
  • Price tooltips — best trader price and flea price on hover, colour-coded by value
  • Multi-select — with UI Fixes, sell many items in one confirmation
  • Flea prices work in raid (needs the included server mod)

Installation

Extract into your SPT root folder (the one containing BepInEx\ and EscapeFromTarkov_Data\). Client goes to BepInEx\plugins\QuickSell\, server to SPT_Runtime\user\mods\QuickSell\.

The server mod is optional — without it, flea prices aren’t available in raid.

Configuration

F12 menu under QuickSell. Tier colours in BepInEx\plugins\QuickSell\config.json.

If you’d like to support my work, you can buy me a coffee ☕

Fixed

  • Selling stopped working after a raid — the mod cached the trader list, but the game rebuilds its trader objects after every raid. It was holding the old ones, so all prices came back empty and you’d get “No items can be sold to traders” until restarting the game.

Thanks to fxh3d for the report.

Fixed

  • Trader price sometimes missing from tooltips — the first tooltip after traders loaded asked for prices before the game had finished fetching them from the server, got nothing back, and cached that empty result. It stayed missing until something cleared the cache, which is why the “Refresh flea prices” button appeared to fix it. Incomplete results are no longer cached, so the next hover fills them in.

Fixed

  • “Item not found in inventory” when listing on the flea — the confirmation flow ran twice once flea prices were cached, so the second pass tried to list items the first had already listed. The offer went up, but you got an error. Fixed by 925316 in #1.
  • Sale could silently do nothing if a price lookup for the same item was already in progress (started by a tooltip). The confirmation window never appeared. Callbacks now queue behind an in-flight request instead of being dropped.

New

  • Sell from backpack, rig and pockets — sell loot without moving it to the stash first. On by default.
  • Sell from secure container — off by default.

Both are in the F12 menu under Selling.

Fixed

  • The keybinds used a separate copy of the location check from the context menu, so the two could disagree. Both now use the same one.
  • Removed the old UI Fixes dependency GUID, which was producing a warning in the log on every launch.

Changed

  • One sell sound per batch. Selling many items at once played the confirmation sound for every item. It now plays once for the whole sale.

Thanks to Elmer-Glue for the fix in #2.

QuickSell v4.0.1 — changes since v3.4.0

  • Trader prices include attachments. QuickSell’s trader tooltip and sale confirmation now account for attached weapon parts. Prices recalculate when attachments or stack counts change.
  • Flea prices include attachments, including nested parts, in tooltips and sale confirmations.
  • New F12 setting: Allow flea market selling. Turning it off blocks both QuickSell flea sales and listings from the normal flea page. Flea buying remains available.
  • New flea price refresh hotkey. You can assign a key in F12 to trigger the existing manual refresh.
  • New sell sound option. Choose whether the sound plays once per batch or once for each item sold.
  • Fixed QuickSell price tooltips appearing on trader-owned items and causing console overflow errors.

Installation: Extract the ZIP into your SPT root folder.

Requires SPT 4.1.3.

QuickSell v4.2.0

  • Optimized price tooltips to eliminate lag and stutter.
  • Improved performance for backpacks, containers and nested items.
  • Improved price cache updates when moving items.
  • Added extra stability fixes.
